title: a11y scroll: use document.scrollingElement.scrollBy via Runtime.evaluate
desc: a11y scroll on Chrome/CDP must use Runtime.evaluate on (document.scrollingElement||documentElement||body).scrollBy, not Input.dispatchMouseEvent deltaY which fails in CI. Also: scroll without #scope is legitimate page-level scroll -- must not auto-redirect to inspect.
steps: BUG ts=2026-05-17T20:15:06: a11y scroll fails universally in CI on real sites
FIX 1 ShouldAutoInspect: exclude scroll from auto-inspect
FIX 2 CdpClient.ScrollAsync uses document.scrollingElement.scrollBy via Runtime.evaluate
Amount aliases: small=120 large=600 page=viewport int=exact default=300
Never use Input.dispatchMouseEvent deltaY for CDP scroll -- requires real mouse focus
author: claude
